definition: Visual closure is a visual processing ability commonly assessed with nonverbal tasks. In this context, it refers to part of how a person processes visual information, and weaknesses in it may contribute independently of phonological skills to reading fluency difficulties such as those seen in developmental dyslexia.

reasons: The packet supports visual closure as a non-verbal visual task/ability, but not that it is “commonly assessed” with nonverbal tasks.
